annotations.title: Is this member free on a date?

description: Whether ONE named member (artist or venue, by profile id from search/get_profile) is free on a specific date. Free-by-default: "available" means nothing is marked against that date. Use this for "is X free on the 14th?"; use search_available_performers to find WHO is free.

member.description: The member's profile SLUG from a search result (e.g. "jason-and-the-donovans"). A profile id is also accepted.

name: check_member_availability
title: Is this member free on a date?
